copy.en:
Separate Wet And Dry Packing
A dedicated bag keeps damp items apart from packed clothes.
Polyester lining, two compartments and X-shaped packing straps
Four side hooks and one metal hook on top
copy.zh:
干湿分离，收纳更有序
独立干湿分离袋，让湿衣物与其他衣物分开放置
涤纶内衬、双区分隔与X型固定带
侧面四个挂钩，上方一个金属挂钩
copy.de:
Nasses und Trockenes getrennt packen
Das separate Nassfach hält feuchte Kleidung vom übrigen Gepäck fern.
Polyesterfutter, zwei Bereiche und X-förmige Packgurte
Vier Seitenhaken und ein Metallhaken oben
copy.fr:
Séparer le sec et l’humide
Le sac dédié éloigne les vêtements humides du reste des affaires.
Doublure polyester, deux zones et sangles en X
Quatre crochets latéraux et un crochet métallique supérieur
copy.it:
Separare asciutto e bagnato
La tasca dedicata tiene gli indumenti umidi separati dal resto.
Fodera in poliestere, due scomparti e cinghie a X
Quattro ganci laterali e un gancio metallico superiore
copy.es:
Separar lo seco y lo húmedo
El bolsillo específico mantiene la ropa húmeda separada del resto.
Forro de poliéster, dos compartimentos y correas en X
Cuatro ganchos laterales y un gancho metálico superior

design_brief_zh: 主卖点是箱内干湿分离袋，核心购买理由是将湿衣物与其他衣物分开放置；以打开的行李箱内部作为主视觉证明，并用侧面挂钩细节补充收纳便利性。PC画布为1464×600：左侧产品区域约[0.05,0.08,0.46,0.84]，采用箱体三分之二侧前方角度，箱盖打开并清晰露出涤纶内衬、干湿分离袋、双区分隔和X型固定带；箱体侧面同时露出四个挂钩，上方金属挂钩以局部放大细节呈现。右侧文案区为[0.57,0.1,0.38,0.8]，按从上到下排列：第1行标题突出干湿分离；第2行说明湿衣物与其他衣物分开；第3行标注涤纶内衬、双区分隔和X型固定带；第4行标注侧面四个挂钩及上方一个金属挂钩。德语文案预留约20%横向扩展空间。移动端为1200×900：上方产品与场景区域[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，下方文案区域[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，重新堆叠为标题、说明、两条细节，确保四行不遮挡产品。整体采用欧洲现代旅行摄影、低饱和中性色和自然侧光；展示真实的聚碳酸酯/ABS箱体、铝合金框架与竖条纹表面，避免夸张反光。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题较粗，细节文字清晰易读，中文和数字保持足够字距。360°双排轮、手机支架和可折叠水杯架可作为次级画面细节出现，但本模块没有“静音”证据，不在文案或视觉中暗示静音性能。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的干湿分离袋、涤纶内衬、双区分隔、X型固定带及挂钩事实；不得宣称静音、绝对耐用、官方认证或其他未提供的性能。图片须准确呈现产品结构，不添加竞品标识、虚构图标、评分、促销信息或未经证实的容量与适配承诺。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ navigation carousel frame for the YWJ 13A travel suitcase, using a European modern travel photography style, low-saturation neutral colors, and soft natural side lighting. Follow a PC composition of 1464x600 with the suitcase occupying the left 46% and the text-safe area on the right 38%; for mobile, use a 1200x900 composition with the product and travel scene in the upper 53% and a clean text-safe area in the lower 31%. Show the suitcase in a realistic three-quarter side-front angle with the lid open: clearly reveal the polyester lining, dry-wet separation bag, two interior compartments, and X-shaped packing straps. Include a tasteful close-up inset of the four side hooks and the single metal hook on the top, with the hooks visibly attached to the suitcase. Secondary visual details may show the 360-degree double wheels, foldable phone holder on the handle, and foldable cup holder, but do not imply silent performance. Preserve the supplied silver, gunmetal gray, or black suitcase appearance, vertical exterior texture, aluminum frame, and four protective corners. Use subtle depth-of-field, accurate materials, realistic proportions, and clear product-focused lighting. Leave generous uncluttered space for four lines of copy in the designated text area. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, badges, icons, watermarks, or interface elements in the image.
